parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Determine the amplitude of the oscillations.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the angular frequency of the oscillations.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers in (a)(i) and (a)(ii) to show that the maximum drift speed $v_0$ of the electron is $1.1 \times 10^{-7} \text{m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
The rod has a cross-sectional area of $4.3 \text{cm}^2$ and contains a number density of conduction electrons (charge carriers) of $8.5 \times 10^{28} \text{m}^{-3}$.

All of the conduction electrons in the rod may be assumed to be oscillating in phase with, and with the same amplitude as, the oscillation shown in Fig. 4.1.
parts.text: Use the information in (a)(iii) to calculate the magnitude $I_0$ of the maximum current in the rod.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
(b)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers in (a)(ii) and (b)(i) to determine an expression for $I$ in terms of $t$, where $I$ is in A and $t$ is in s.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Determine the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) current in the rod.
